name: 战争与逃难
source: 《申报》上海版，1937年11月20日，第2版
source_en: Shen Bao, Shanghai edition, 20 Nov 1937, p. 2
quote: 蘇崑難民追述沿途艱苦慘狀
body: 报道记录苏州、昆山一带逃难者经嘉兴、杭州、宁波抵达上海的经历。与周庄临时收容所的记述并读，可观察1937年江南地区的人口流动。
body_en: The newspaper recounts a journey from the Suzhou–Kunshan area through Jiaxing, Hangzhou and Ningbo to Shanghai. It offers a regional perspective on wartime movement.
extract: 同行十一人僅五人到達；有車搭車，倘遇警報，則紛紛下車，伏於田野中以避。
quote_en: Refugees from Suzhou and Kunshan recount the hardships of their journey

name: 河道与封锁
source: 《贞丰八年血泪录》所记河道封锁；DKU藏昆山历史地图作区域对照
source_en: Diary account and historical Kunshan regional map, DKU Archives
body: 朱润苍记录了河港、孔道的封锁措施。昆山旧图呈现区域水网环境，具体筑坝地点仍待考证。
body_en: Zhu describes blocking waterways. The regional map helps explain the landscape but does not locate a particular barricade or stand in for a street-level Zhouzhuang map.

name: 地方武装
source: 《申报》上海版，1941年2月16日，第10版
source_en: Shen Bao, Shanghai edition, 16 Feb 1941, p. 10
body: 报道记述周庄西北朱家湖附近的战斗，称“陈躍宗团部”。日记多次提到“陈耀宗部”。两份资料中的姓名写法及事件日期尚待核实。
body_en: The report names fighting near Zhujia Lake northwest of Zhouzhuang and a commander written as “Chen Yuezong.” The spelling and dates do not establish identity with every action described in the diary.
extract: 在吳縣周莊鎮西北之朱家湖與陳團發生遭遇戰
quote_en: Zhujia Lake, northwest of Zhouzhuang Town

name: 清乡与证件
source: 周德华，《“清乡”在吴江》，《吴江文史资料》第15辑，1995，印刷第72页起
source_en: Zhou Dehua, “Pacification in Wujiang,” Wujiang Historical Materials, vol. 15 (1995), from p. 72
body: 周德华回顾吴江地区“清乡”政策的组织与实施，为阅读日记中的清乡机构、户口核查和证件检查提供制度背景。
body_en: This retrospective local history explains pacification structures in neighboring Wujiang. It provides institutional context, with a distinct geographic and documentary scope.

name: 军米与商号
source: 《申报》上海版，1943年10月13日，第3版，《米粮统制委员会通告第五号》
source_en: Shen Bao, 13 Oct 1943, p. 3, Rice Control Committee Notice No. 5
body: 1943年粮食统制通告列有“吴江周庄镇”的“义丰”“恒昇”等商号。结合朱润苍对强征军米的记述，可观察占领时期的地方粮食管理。
body_en: The notice lists rice merchants in “Wujiang, Zhouzhuang Town,” including Yifeng and Hengsheng. This is a concrete town-level connection, but not the requisition order described by Zhu.
extract: 吳江 義豐 … 吳江周莊鎭；恒昇 … 吳江周莊鎭

name: 征粮的区域背景
source: 吴根荣，《日伪在吴江强征军米概述》，《吴江文史资料》第15辑，1995，印刷第76页起
source_en: Wu Genrong, “An Overview of Forced Military Rice Requisition in Wujiang,” Wujiang Historical Materials 15 (1995), from p. 76
quote: 日伪在吴江强征军米概述
body: 《日伪在吴江强征军米概述》回顾吴江地区的军米征收与基层摊派。其统计范围为吴江地区，周庄的具体数量以日记原文为准。
body_en: The retrospective essay connects military rice requisitions with the occupation economy. Its regional figures must not be presented as Zhouzhuang totals.
quote_en: An overview of forced military rice requisition in Wujiang

name: 一份记录的后来
source: 朱润苍自序（1946）；唐湛声序（1947）；《近代史资料》总54号（1984）
source_en: Zhu’s preface (1946); Tang’s preface (1947); Modern Historical Materials 54 (1984)
quote: 局处穷牖，默记日尝痛苦事情
body: 朱润苍在1946年自序中交代战时记事与战后整理的经过，并说明日期使用农历。本站阅读底本来自1984年刊印版本。
body_en: Zhu describes wartime note-taking and postwar editing, warning that entries use the lunar calendar and may omit events. This edition transcribes the 1984 printed publication, not the handwritten manuscript.
quote_en: In my small, secluded room, I quietly recorded the painful events of each day

name: 水路与地方生活
source: 策展阅读提示 · 依据所选原文
source_en: Editorial reading note · based on the selected passage
body: 唐湛声的序文把河道写成交通与战争的条件。阅读后文的河道封锁时，可以回到这段空间描述。
body_en: The preface introduces waterways as transport infrastructure and a condition of war.

name: 消息如何抵达小镇
source: 策展阅读提示 · 依据所选原文
source_en: Editorial reading note · based on the selected passage
body: 开篇写全镇争听无线电，显示远方战局通过声音与消息进入周庄。
body_en: The opening records townspeople listening to radio news of a distant battle.

name: 一张证件的权力
source: 策展阅读提示 · 依据所选原文
source_en: Editorial reading note · based on the selected passage
body: “良民证”在后文多次出现。可沿着1938、1942、1943、1944年的记载，观察控制方式如何改变。
body_en: Permits recur across several years, offering a thread through occupation.

name: 日常生活的尺度
source: 策展阅读提示 · 依据所选原文
source_en: Editorial reading note · based on the selected passage
body: 米价是作者持续记录的生活指标。跨年比较时，币制和计量单位需要分别标注。
body_en: Rice prices recur, but currencies and units change across years.

name: 索取与负担
source: 策展阅读提示 · 依据所选原文
source_en: Editorial reading note · based on the selected passage
body: 这一段同时写到索米、勒款和米价上涨，能够观察军事压力与家庭经济如何交叠。
body_en: This entry connects demands for rice and money with price increases.

name: 价格跨过关口
source: 策展阅读提示 · 依据所选原文
source_en: Editorial reading note · based on the selected passage
body: 与1938年的米价记录并读，可以观察作者如何通过价格记录生活压力。
body_en: Compare with earlier rice prices while keeping monetary context in view.

name: 制度进入日常
source: 策展阅读提示 · 依据所选原文
source_en: Editorial reading note · based on the selected passage
body: “清乡”关联军事行动、占领机构与户口核查。后文的证件检查进一步呈现这些措施的日常影响。
body_en: Pacification here connects military presence with later household registration.

name: 被登记的人
source: 策展阅读提示 · 依据所选原文
source_en: Editorial reading note · based on the selected passage
body: 复查户口与发证并列出现，说明行政登记成为占领统治的一部分。
body_en: Household checks and permits appear together as mechanisms of control.

name: 从证件到惩罚
source: 策展阅读提示 · 依据所选原文
source_en: Editorial reading note · based on the selected passage
body: 将这一段与最初发行“良民证”的记录比较，观察证件从行政措施变为街头检查的工具。
body_en: Compare the issuance of permits with their later coercive enforcement.

name: 不断变化的米价
source: 策展阅读提示 · 依据所选原文
source_en: Editorial reading note · based on the selected passage
body: 这是一条具体年份的价格记录。它的意义在于呈现作者对生活成本的持续关注。
body_en: A dated price entry showing the diarist’s attention to living costs.

name: 通货与饥饿
source: 策展阅读提示 · 依据所选原文
source_en: Editorial reading note · based on the selected passage
body: 这条记录呈现了价格的显著变化。比较不同年份时，需要结合当时的币制。
body_en: The large nominal increase requires currency context before quantitative comparison.

name: 反复发生的检查
source: 策展阅读提示 · 依据所选原文
source_en: Editorial reading note · based on the selected passage
body: 证件检查延续至1944年，与1938年首次发行的记述形成跨年呼应。
body_en: Permit checks continue into 1944, echoing the 1938 issuance.

name: 米价与时间
source: 策展阅读提示 · 依据所选原文
source_en: Editorial reading note · based on the selected passage
body: 作者将粮价变化嵌入事件记述，价格在这里是一种生活经验的时间刻度。
body_en: The diarist uses prices as markers of lived time.

name: 粮食流通受限
source: 策展阅读提示 · 依据所选原文
source_en: Editorial reading note · based on the selected passage
body: 这一段涉及征粮数量、米行交易、民间搬运和船只检查，展示粮食征收对地方经济活动的影响。
body_en: The entry describes controls over merchants, transport and household rice.

name: 战争末期的价格
source: 策展阅读提示 · 依据所选原文
source_en: Editorial reading note · based on the selected passage
body: 1945年的价格记述提示经济压力持续到战争末期。跨年比较仍需区分币制。
body_en: The 1945 price entry suggests continuing pressure, with currency caveats.

name: 受降消息与地方庆祝
source: 策展阅读提示 · 依据所选原文
source_en: Editorial reading note · based on the selected passage
body: 受降消息传来与居民敢于公开庆祝之间存在时间差。结尾将政治事件转化为具体的生活感受。
body_en: The news of surrender and the freedom to celebrate are separated in lived experience.
